About

Unbranded Skincare is a Paris-based, science-first serum line built around seven numbered formulas, each with a clearly declared concentration of active ingredients. Working with XBM Studio, we translated that transparency into product-first imagery, pairing precise, clinical still lifes with unretouched portraits and real skin. Laboratory references and editorial compositions give the visual language a human edge.
